carry_forward_constraints: S29 must not treat Level-2/CF-2 as passed merely because S28 starts Level 3; preserve the minimal regression pack for S26 critical controls until those contracts are actually green.
Use actual pytest assertions for S29 repository/transaction/migration tests; print-only booleans from S27-S28 are not evidence.
Use reserved synthetic domains such as .test/example.com in fixtures and never real-looking example.pe endpoints.
Do not let missing identifiers/names become positive identity evidence. Empty-empty token similarity=1.0 from S28 is MISCONCEPTION_RISK and must not drive candidate/entity merges.
Define one shared Unicode normalization policy before persistence—e.g. NFC plus casefold/whitespace rules as appropriate—and test NFC/NFD round trips against the actual repository API.

S29 schema/constraints must enforce the typed contracts S28 only narrated: whitespace-only IDs invalid, explicit score type/coercion policy, finite score domain, uniqueness/cardinality where applicable, and fail-closed batch behavior.

Golden/snapshot fixtures used for repository tests must be real versioned artifacts with canonical ordering and auditable reviewer/timestamp/reason/hash when changed; approved=True is not proof of review.
Any DB/HTTP fake used by S29 must implement an application-owned interface or be checked with spec/autospec/contract tests; fake success is not provider compatibility evidence.

SQLite tests may validate local relational logic but must not be cited as proof of Postgres-specific dialect, isolation, locking, indexing or migration behavior; if S29 claims those semantics, test the actual engine/version/config or clearly bound the claim.
Repository/integration tests must assert exact observable results and transaction/history invariants; returning/printing rows is not a gate.
Carry S28's unfinished timeout/restart requirements into persistence tests: checkpoint/resume must survive reopening a persistent store, not just an in-memory object.
Distinguish deterministic ordering required by a query contract from arbitrary ordering that should be canonicalized only in tests; do not sort away a production-order bug.
Keep behavioral contract tests separate from provider-consumer/interface contract tests in naming and documentation.
Do not use global random.seed inside repository tests; isolate RNG per fixture/test if randomized data is needed.

S29 should test the exact relational-history requirement from its roadmap: source records, entities, candidate pairs, decisions and evidence must remain reconstructable rather than overwritten by upsert convenience.
